Callout.Name: Lane Closure
Callout.Message: Request to close a lane for a recovery.
Callout.Advisory: Recovery truck on scene, traffic down to one lane.

Script.Line: I need that lane shut for the recovery. Fifteen minutes.
The traffic will be a mile back by the time we are done.
Cones out before the lorry arrives, not after.

Lines.Approach: The truck is there and the traffic is backing up. Somebody needs to stand in the road.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
